title: Source ownership
responsibility: Lists implementation and associated test files separately, opening exact committed text in the shared read-only modal.

inputs.name: EntitySource.unit
inputs.description: Required unit with recorded owned source paths and optional revision-bound responsibility category.

inputs.name: EntitySource.entity
inputs.description: Entity identity supplied by the host for per-file code actions.

inputs.name: EntitySource.nav
inputs.description: Revision-scoped modal callback; an unhosted source list remains read-only.

inputs.name: EntitySource.repository
inputs.description: Public GitHub repository used for commit-pinned file links; unsupported values remain plain paths.

inputs.name: EntitySource.commit
inputs.description: Full commit hash supplying the displayed files and GitHub links.

outputs.name: EntitySource
outputs.description: Lists implementation and associated test files separately. Service labels omit the implied src/services/ root while file links and code actions retain complete paths. The modal reads archived committed text; unavailable revisions state gaps.
